session-reconnect-reconcile.reason: Frozen Go waits for its 30-second refresh worker after a session_revoke LISTEN gap. The reviewed AUTHRT fix requires Rust to refresh immediately after subscribing, before processing queued notifications.
session-reconnect-reconcile.original_evidence: Original test observed no closure within 5s; periodic refresh closed the session at 30s (AUTHRT-review-imap-reconnect-red.log).

lockout-check-fail-closed.reason: Go treats a failed lockout_check (pool exhaustion included) as not locked; an attacker-driven stall must not disable lockout.

spray-detect-fail-closed.reason: Same attack class. Consequence: an unparseable source_ip (IMAP "unknown" with no peer, imap/src/auth.rs:125-128) is rejected; ip_rules rejects it first.

ip-rules-fail-closed.reason: Saturating the request pool must not bypass an operator IP block; same unparseable-IP consequence.

rate-limit-fail-closed.reason: A rate-limit store failure must not lift the limit.

captcha-count-fail-closed.reason: An attacker can slow their own count; HTTP only (`skip_captcha=false`), no current caller.

worker-credential-boot-probe.reason: Go silently fails open when the lockout pool lacks EXECUTE; Rust refuses boot on 42501.

http-lockout-ip-key-without-username.reason: Go skips the lockout step when the username is empty, so an unparseable or email-less credential body escaped an armed ip: lock. HTTP (protocol "http") now checks the ip: key alone in that case; protocol listeners are unchanged.
http-lockout-ip-key-without-username.review: #349a Fable plan review F1; owner policy: security Go bugs are fixed in Rust
